{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZiGBdQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDI7TA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 43, "title": "Reproduce a bounded pre-physics PMX IK/append profile through glTF, VMD/VPD and Demo", "body": "## Problem

Converted rigs retain bone hierarchy but omit IK, append and deformation ordering. VMD playback and VPD application therefore produce raw transforms even when a pose depends on solver behavior. The omission is explicit in `tools/pmx-to-gltf.ts`; shared integration points exist in `packages/three-mmd-vpd/index.ts` and `packages/three-mmd-vmd/index.ts`.

## Expected outcome

Deliver one complete pre-physics profile across extension definitions, converter, reusable Three.js APIs and the existing Demo: ordered IK with unconstrained and single-axis limited links, plus rotation/translation append in local and non-local modes, including chained append and IK-to-append interaction.

Use core joints/TRS for resolved poses and sampled animation fallback. Define a runtime-independent extension only for missing solver information and behavior; extend existing VMD transport where necessary. Preserve legacy solver-free assets and existing Toon/Outline conventions.

Post-physics evaluation, simulation, external-parent coupling, fixed-axis-dependent IK and general multi-axis constraints remain outside this bounded profile. Preserve their solver records and report unsupported dependencies explicitly. Remaining morph families, physics, scene controls, representative fidelity, VMD animation and VPD poses remain mandatory overall work.

## Context

At inspection, clean HEAD and remote main match `fa2f3a15968fd8533f6677b2a64159d599b775a7`; the [open Issue collection](https://api.github.com/repos/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues?state=open&per_page=100), including PRs, is empty.

[PR #42](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/42) reports 71 Node passes, 32 browser passes and two optional WebGPU skips. Relevant tests and saved measurements are present. [Hosted execution](https://api.github.com/repos/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40050548969/jobs) reports successful build/typecheck/Node steps but browser execution remains in progress. These are distinct evidence states; no suites were rerun for this proposal.

The [PMX format-author document mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt) describes phase/layer/index ordering, local deformation followed by IK at the controller's turn, and separate input, append and IK contributions. It describes format/editor behavior, not measured original-MMD execution.

Retain this correction: **old assumption:** local append is ignored when its source also appends. **Corrected requirement:** local append takes priority. **Source:** the author's [0216b amendment](https://kkhk22.seesaa.net/article/312703073.html). **Rationale:** the amendment supersedes the struck-through exception; local append is also distinct from local editing axes. Original-MMD adoption remains unresolved.

[Core glTF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/main/specification/2.0/Specification.adoc) supplies resolved joint transforms and animation. Official [CCDIKSolver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/examples/jsm/animation/CCDIKSolver.js) offers reusable per-chain machinery; the historical [MMDAnimationHelper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r169/examples/jsm/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.js) has incomplete grant handling. Neither establishes MMD fidelity. An [upstream first-hand report](https://github.com/MMD-Blender/blender_mmd_tools/issues/152) raises version-dependent fixed-axis behavior without controlled measurements, supporting explicit exclusion rather than an assumed mapping.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add the extension contract, schema, minimal valid example and invalid fixtures, wired into `npm test`. Specify references, units/handedness, original-rest inputs, defaults, quaternion composition, append rates, evaluation order, hinge-limit coordinates, iteration/angle caps, degenerate cases and supported dependency restrictions. Clearly label unmeasured choices as project policies. A minimal glTF example must work without PMX-specific extras or material extensions.
- [ ] Implement API/CLI conversion for the profile through existing skinning modes and GLB/external-buffer glTF output. Retain source solver identities, flags, phases, links, limits and append data. Validate references, counts, finite ranges and supported dependencies before output; malformed or out-of-profile execution requests fail with indexed diagnostics and without partial output. Existing solver-free conversion remains available with truthful loss reports.
- [ ] Use a shared evaluator for conversion, live VMD and VPD paths. Resolve from original inputs on each evaluation; repeated seek/application must not accumulate solver output. Refresh matrices, skin palettes and deformation bounds after solving. Preserve instance isolation, ownership, failure atomicity, reset, replacement and disposal behavior.
- [ ] Execute bound VMD IK-enable records with documented defaults, name binding, duplicate/unmatched policy and boundary semantics. Preserve model-visibility records with explicit non-execution diagnostics. Exact playback consumes raw curves and solves once; it replaces the complete matching fallback animation. Fallback contains resolved channels for every solver-affected joint. Document approximation around IK switches, include boundary probes, and reject unrepresentable accuracy/sample-budget requests rather than silently smoothing controls.
- [ ] Add attributed synthetic PMX fixtures with two distinct chain geometries/hierarchies and two solver-bearing VMD motions; exercise both motions on both rigs and both VPD poses on each rig. Include noncommuting rotations, translation append, chained/local append, layer/index ties and an IK-updated append source. Cover reachable, limited/unreachable, zero-length and antiparallel cases, disabled/re-enabled IK and unsupported dependencies. Expected results must use independent analytical calculations or independently authored reference calculations, not production evaluator output.
- [ ] For deliberately solvable analytical fixtures, require joint-orientation error ≤1e-5 rad and CPU joint/vertex position error ≤2e-6 m; compare constrained/unreachable cases with their predicted result rather than demanding zero residual. Compare direct bytes, extension GLB/glTF and ordinary-loader fallback at keys, control boundaries and fractional samples. Retain existing fallback tolerances, sample limits and documented finite-probe limitations.
- [ ] Add focused solver-before-BDEF/SDEF/QDEF deformation probes, including vertex/group weights, surface and Outline paths. Retain existing GPU position ≤1e-4 m, normal-component ≤5e-4 and raster comparison limits. Include solver-disabled and deliberately incorrect-order negative controls so passing evidence demonstrates the new behavior.
- [ ] Extend the built Demo through its actual converter/plugins: both rigs/motions via bytes/GLB/glTF, play/pause/seek/loop/endpoints, observable IK controls, both VPD handoffs/reset/resumed motion, failed-load recovery and replacement/disposal. Pair predicted joints/vertices with matching rendered revisions and saved canvases. Export applied states as GLB/glTF, validate/reload them and check repeated pose application/reset without double solving; retain original-rest identity.
- [ ] The Coordinator records actual outcomes for `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, Chromium installation, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Extend existing suites and preserve justified regression scenarios, thresholds and timeouts. Record failures, skips, environment, asset provenance and numerical/rendered results separately from test presence. Existing optional native-WebGPU cases remain optional.

Evidence-backed corrections to AI-authored requirements are permitted: retain the old assumption, corrected requirement, primary source and rationale in the Issue/PR. No human approval or independent AI re-review is required. Corrections must preserve the agreed goal and justified acceptance, rather than accommodate unfinished implementation or failing tests. Implementation, testing and normal PR review remain with the Coordinator.

## Optional validation

Controlled, version-labelled original-MMD measurements of the same lawful synthetic fixtures, particularly append composition and IK constraint boundaries. Compare them separately from analytical conformance and alternative renderers; the repository's original-MMD observations remain uncaptured. Native WebGPU observations are also optional.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
